name: Thalia
source:
A Mythology teacher with a penchant for the unusual. She's a moderator and has 1,000+ posts on the talkparanormal.com forum. The type of person who drinks an entire bottle of wine and stays up until two in the morning browsing Gunne Sax dresses on eBay. Would like an espresso machine and a boyfriend (preferably a time lord, or else a man with a high paying job) for Christmas.

[From [url=https://pbjelly.itch.io/insatiable-creatures]itch.io[/url]]
